test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Sun Tzu says that ______ the enemy without battle requires greater skill than winning on the battlefield.
solution:
The correct answer is: **defeating**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Defeated **is the past form of the verb defeat. It is used in past tense sentences.
 
• **Defeating** is the (verb+ing) of the gerund form of "defeat".
 
• **In defeating** means having lost.
 
• **Defeat **(verb) means to win a game, a fight, a vote, etc. against somebody; to beat somebody.
 
• Gerunds can be used as a subject of a sentence and as an instance when a verb is being used in a very particular way – as a noun.
 
• **The implied meaning of the sentence is:** According to Sun Tzu, overcoming an opponent without engaging in combat needs more skill than doing so.
 
• So, In the given sentence the gerund **(defeating)** should be used because it is acting as the subject of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *Sun Tzu says that defeating __the enemy without battle requires greater skill than winning on the battlefield. *
